description.narrative: The Preparedness in Practice Project seeks to translate preparedness assessments, identified organisational priorities and emerging preparedness needs into practical and measurable improvements in National Society readiness. It combines targeted country-level investments with regional learning and technical support, recognising that many preparedness challenges and their solutions are shared across National Societies. The activities build on priorities identified through PER processes and related preparedness assessments, while supporting National Societies in strengthening their role within national disaster risk management systems. Regional investments provide the technical support, peer learning and knowledge exchange that amplify and sustain country-level results.
